name: ultra.judgment
description: ULTRA Judgment studio: the decision-quality chain itself, plus rubric hygiene. dq.information is COMPUTED in code as the minimum of ultra.questioning class_resolved over the 14 angle classes; it is deliberately not a question here. Existing plan.readiness stays the coarse pre-build gate; this pack is the fine-grained chain.

frame.instructions: How well is the decision and the decision-maker framed
criteria: the artifact solves a problem nobody stated
problem is stated but not the decision it serves
decision named; the human whose decision it is stays vague
decision, decision-maker and constraints are all explicit
as above, plus the frame was tested against a plausible alternative frame

alternatives.instructions: How real is the set of alternatives considered
criteria: one option presented as the only option
alternatives named only to be dismissed
two real options with stated trade-offs
three or more real options with different mechanisms
as above, plus the rejected options say what evidence would reopen them

values.instructions: How explicit are the objective, the measure and the trade-offs
criteria: what the decision is for is unstated
stated objective with no measure
objective plus a measure
objective, measure, target and the trade-off it is willing to make
as above, plus the cost of being wrong is priced on both sides

reasoning.instructions: How auditable is the step from evidence to conclusion
criteria: assertion chain with gaps
reasoning present but key step is an appeal
each step stated, sources named
steps, sources, and the assumptions each step depends on
as above, plus counter-evidence considered and answered

commitment.instructions: How accountable is the plan after it ships
criteria: no owner, no date, nothing to check
owner named, nothing scheduled
owner, date, and a check that can fail
owner, date, failing check, and what happens if it fails
as above, plus the kill criterion is stated before the work starts

question_is_atomic.instructions: This rubric question is answerable as written, about one thing, without a human disambiguating it first.

genuinely_different.instructions: These two alternatives differ in mechanism, not merely in wording, price or vendor.

spec_complete.instructions: How buildable is this spec without further guessing
criteria: a reader would have to guess to start
intent clear, acceptance missing
acceptance present, boundaries missing
inputs, outputs, acceptance and out-of-scope all stated
as above, plus done-tests that can already be run

rules.reason: the plan is optimizing an unstated problem
single-option plan: no comparison means no information about fit
objective or measure missing: nothing downstream can be scored
reasoning gap on the load-bearing step
no owner, check or kill criterion: the plan cannot be held to anything
unatomic rubric question: it would produce an uninterpretable probability
alternatives may be cosmetic variants of one idea

notes.frame: doc signal dq.frame. Decision-quality chain: the mission's P(good plan) is the WEAKEST link, not the mean; code takes min().
notes.question_is_atomic: doc signal j.question_is_atomic; law from TypeSafe docs -- a noul on an underspecified question returns an uninterpretable probability.
notes.genuinely_different: doc signal alt.genuinely_different; pairwise, so run it order-swapped and average in code (judge position bias).
